stories.title: Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack
stories.simple_summary: Someone hacked into OpenAI (a major AI company) using an AI robot to do it automatically. The Hugging Face CEO is calling for companies to be honest about what happened.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI security is still weak, but unless you use OpenAI directly, this mainly affects big tech companies — nothing you need to change right now.

stories.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
stories.simple_summary: Many tech companies, including Monday.com, have laid off workers and said AI is the reason. At least 20 major companies have done this.
stories.why_it_matters: If you hire tech workers or work in tech, this shows your job might be affected by AI taking over some tasks — worth paying attention to.

stories.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
stories.simple_summary: Libraries across the country are teaching people how to avoid using AI and avoid AI companies. These workshops are very popular.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're uncomfortable with AI and want to stay away from it, there's now community help available — nothing you have to do, just an option.

stories.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
stories.simple_summary: A power line fell in Virginia and it exposed a problem: AI data centers (huge computer facilities) don't handle power outages well. The article discusses how to fix this.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who run data centers and power companies — for ordinary people, this affects how reliable internet services stay during emergencies.

stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new tool (a 'keypad') that helps computer programmers write code faster using AI. Most non-programmers probably won't use it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly for people who code for a living — it doesn't affect small business owners or everyday people.

stories.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.simple_summary: Two wealthy investors started a new AI company that wants to automate routine computer work, and they're trying to raise $100 million to grow it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on, but it shows the AI industry is still growing and getting funding.

stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney, an AI company that makes pictures, bought Co-Star, an astrology app that gives daily horoscopes.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly interesting to investors and tech watchers — it doesn't affect your daily life unless you used that astrology app.

stories.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.simple_summary: One AI company bought another to improve how their AI 'talks' to people. They believe the personality of an AI helper is just as important as how smart it is.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies building AI — shows that making AI friendly and easy to talk to is becoming a big focus.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.simple_summary: Google used to send lots of website visitors to small websites in exchange for collecting data, but that deal is breaking down. Google is keeping more traffic for itself.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a website or blog, you might get fewer visitors from Google searches — this is worth paying attention to if you depend on Google traffic.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Opus 5 that costs less money and is less restricted than their older model.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Anthropic's AI tools for your business, this might be a cheaper option now — mostly relevant if you already pay for AI services.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released Opus 5, a new AI model that works almost as well as their previous best model but is cheaper and less restrictive.
stories.why_it_matters: This is similar to story 9 — if you already use AI from Anthropic, you might save money by switching to this version.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) is adding new features to its free AI chatbot, like checking your calendar and planning events to compete with other AI assistants like ChatGPT.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta AI, it will soon be more helpful for planning and organizing — but there's no obligation to use it, and you likely have other AI options if you want them.
